baseNote: Branched from codex/m1-041-keyboard-decoder (PR #339) at baseCommit. After #339 merged, origin/main was merged in (a fast-forward to mergedMainCommit), and the first M1-043 commit followed. This file records the independent-review round: every entry after the RED run ran on testedTreeParentCommit plus the staged review fixes. The RED run was taken first, on baseCommit with the stub; the first round's gate entries are in this file's git history.

testRenames.change: renamed after the RED run (fresh-context review); same checks

added after the RED run (independent review): the source checks split out of productionSourceImportsOnlyKVMContracts, now also covering decimal literals and block comments; the RED run had 14 tests and the suite now has 15

note: Run by the implementing agent (Claude Opus 5.5) on the staged M1-043 tree whose parent is testedTreeParentCommit; testedFiles gives the git blob of each tested file. The reviewer must rerun. Expected failures: the entries with expectedFailure true (red, mutations-previous-suite) were meant to fail; the RED run tests the suite against a compiling stub with the design's API and no behavior, and its output keeps the test names of that time (see testRenames). The mutations-previous-suite run is expected to exit 1: it runs mutant 8, a behavior-neutral decimal literal, against the test file of the first M1-043 commit, which misses it (evidence/issues/M1-043/mutations/mutations-previous-suite.json). The mutations entry exits 0 only when every mutant is killed by the current suite; each mutant's own suite run is expected to fail, as listed in evidence/issues/M1-043/mutations/mutations.json. Every other entry must exit 0. Deviation (lead's decision 3): the issue's `swift test --package-path Packages/KVMCore` is replaced by `swift test --package-path Packages/BarrierCompatibility`, because Packages/KVMCore has no Package.swift and M4-SCOPE-001 moved the Exact Files to BarrierCompatibility. Long outputs keep their first 25 and last 80 lines, lines longer than 400 characters are cut, and --tests-only runs keep only the per-test result lines. Paths are masked: <repository> is the worktree, <worktree> its directory name, <main-checkout> the main checkout, <producer-scratch> the agent's scratch directory, <home> any other home path, <host> the host name.
